name: agenttrace
description: Open-source AI agent observability and debugging platform with distributed tracing, live monitoring and a TypeScript SDK.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build:shared && npm run build:sdk
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w agenttrace-sdk && npm run build -w @agenttrace/shared && npm run build -w @agenttrace/api && npm run build -w @agenttrace/dashboard
scripts.demo:agent: npm run build -w agenttrace-sdk && npm run start -w @agenttrace/example-basic-agent
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
